result: Adding a perturbation and negative curvature exploitation to Nesterov's method finds ε-second-order stationary points in Õ(ε^{−7/4}) iterations, faster than gradient descent's Õ(ε^{−2}), using only gradients.
result_plain: Perturbed accelerated GD escapes saddles faster than GD: Õ(ε^−7/4) iterations.
